definitions.explanation: The designated area at an airport where passengers board their aircraft.

examples.japanese: {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧23⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧です。
{搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The boarding gate has been changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧30{分前|ぷんまえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come to the boarding gate at least 30 minutes before departure.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ (boarding) + {口|ぐち} (entrance/exit). An essential airport term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head to the boarding gate
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait at the boarding gate
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: gate number
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: gate change

RELATED AIRPORT TERMS:
- ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧: boarding
- ⟦{搭乗券|とうじょうけん}→搭乗券：17977_toujouken⟧: boarding pass
- ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: boarding procedures / check-in
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}ロビー→出発ロビー：26118_shuppatsurobii⟧: departure lobby
- ⟦ゲート→ゲート：10851_geeto⟧: gate (English loanword, also commonly used)

USAGE:
In airport announcements, you will hear {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}. Casually, the loanword ⟦ゲート→ゲート：10851_geeto⟧ is also used. Printed boarding passes and airport signs typically show both.
